name: branch-pr
displayName: Branch PR: pull request / merge request descriptions
description: Writes a brief, copy-paste-ready Markdown PR/MR description for the current git branch from its diff, commits and requirements: overview, list of changes, caveats (migrations, env vars, breaking changes, unmet requirements) and short QA test scenarios, plus a Conventional Commits title (type and scope). Fills the repo's own template when it has one and copies the result to the clipboard.
